en.html:
An indictment.

A condemnation.

She knew.
What I had done. What I had done to the person she cherished. All of it, she knew.

Konatsu Kurusuno pronouncing sentence: the killing of Yuhi Nitta, my crime.
Justice without one flaw. Nothing missing. Nothing to dispute.

ja.html:
弾劾。

　断罪。

　彼女は知っているのだ。
　俺が何をしたのか、彼女の大切な人に何をしたのか、
知っているのだ。

　あれは新田雄飛殺害の罪科を鳴らす、来栖野小夏の
裁断宣告。
　絶対無欠の正義表明。

Move your body toward me—
